item.text: The failures point to two implementation gaps: slugification is replacing each invalid character independently and isn’t Unicode-normalizing accented letters; truncation is only looking backward from the limit, so it misses a word that ends exactly at the limit. I’m checking the project guidance and then I’ll patch both behaviors against the written spec.
